At least 80% of guests must stay at the resort at a full inclusive rate

External DJ volume limits: 60 dB 2-7 pm, 55 dB 7-10 pm

No outside food or drink; no personal speakers; no sky lanterns or fireworks; no own string lights

Extra international open bar $18 per hour per person

Wood dance floor for 90-110 people $1,500
Mexican Plaza private dinner rental $1,000 (100 to 250 people)

Deposit to hold the date: $500 (Eternal Love, Secret Garden), $750 (Beyond Memorable, Dulha & Dulhan)
80% of the wedding contract due 20 days before, 20% up to 3 days before
Free cancellation 6+ months out; inside 6 months the deposit is kept
Rain backup re-setup fee for 150-200 people $2,500 + tax
Welcome events: Taco Night $50 pp, Bonfire party $40 pp (2 hours, min 25)
